title.en: A short conversation about careful reading
title.zh: 关于认真阅读的一段对话

introduction.en: This fictional exchange demonstrates the layout of a conversation between a host and a guest. The names are role labels, not real people.
introduction.zh: 这段虚构对话用于展示主持人与嘉宾问答的版式。人物名称是角色标记，不指向真实人物。

text.en: Original text written for this skill's formatting example; no external interview is reproduced.
text.zh: 为本技能排版示例原创的文字，未转载外部访谈。

text.en: What do you check before changing a sentence?
text.zh: 修改一句话之前，你会先检查什么？

text.en: I check its context. Keeping the word not can be more important than making the sentence shorter.
text.zh: 我会先检查上下文。保留一个“不”字，可能比把句子改短更重要。

text.en: [Unclear word] What if one term remains uncertain?
text.zh: [听辨不清] 如果仍有一个词不能确认呢？

text.en: I keep the uncertainty visible. A 10% estimate is not an exact count, and A & B are two labels.
text.zh: 我会保留这个疑点。10% 的估计并不是精确计数，A & B 是两个标记。
